youtube.title: Too Much Noise In Your Head? Night Prayer Before Sleep | Psalm 85:8 KJV
youtube.text:
Too much noise in your head tonight? Hear this.

"I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly." Psalm 85:8 (KJV)

Fall asleep to the Word: Psalms 79–104, KJV, read slowly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9omyQM3ULPU

Type amen, and send this to someone who can't sleep.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#NightPrayer #BibleVersesForSleep #KJV #BlessedPrayers #ChristmasPrayer #shorts
